assertions.source: Granny knot = trefoil # trefoil; without this a table of 1s is an artefact.

assertions.name: prime_control_does_not_split
assertions.source: Trefoil is prime; without this a table of >1s is an artefact.

assertions.name: every_branch_resolved
assertions.source: An unresolved branch makes the classification incomplete.

description: Classifies every atom-element branch closure by number of prime summands, to decide WHICH case of the Stage-3 Geom(K) split applies. The branches are already measured non-hyperbolic; non-hyperbolic is torus OR reducible, and a connected sum is in neither -- Stage 3 has no case for a composite. Carries a composite control (granny knot must split) and a prime control (trefoil must not).

the_rule_the_framework_states.stage_3: Geom(K) = Vol(K)/hbar_q^2 for HYPERBOLIC K (mass/energy); CS(K)*hbar_q^2 for TORUS K (coupling phase); 0 for the UNKNOT (vacuum)
the_rule_the_framework_states.applied_in_alpha_EM: predicted-spectra/em-coupling-chern-simons.md: 'The torus knots T_{2,9} and T_{3,5} are non-hyperbolic. Their tau-image geometric invariant is the Chern-Simons functional, not the hyperbolic volume.'
the_rule_the_framework_states.not_applied_in_mass: the mass path applies Vol(K)/hbar_q^2 unconditionally, with Vol(B_3) substituted, to carriers measured non-hyperbolic
